Client Outreach Automator v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a skill to generate personalized cold outreach sequences for businesses.
- Supports multi-touch email sequences, LinkedIn messages, and cold call scripts.
- Adapts outreach templates to various industries and business sizes using personalization tokens.
- Activates with relevant outreach-related user requests.
- Includes sample templates for real estate, photography, consulting, and more.
- Follows best practices for sales messaging, personalization, and conversion.
